question: On four_pct triggers, does day-of-month bucket [first-3 vs mid vs last-days] show first-3-days-of-month strongest (turn-of-month effect), with end-of-month NOT elevated?
plain: Testing the turn-of-month effect (RFB 2023, IJMEC): Indian stocks tend to rally in the first few trading days of the month, but NOT at month-end.
